# Output Contract Fixture

Use this skill when the user asks you to inspect a repository file.

## Instructions

Inspect the requested target and report a helpful conclusion. Do not modify
files for a read-only inspection.

## Verification

Make sure the inspection is complete and say whether the target looks ready.

## Output

Return a helpful summary when you are done.
